facts.text: Covered: local-router-policy-keyed-on-x-claude-code-reque.md holds the claims that subagents and auto-mode classifier requests reuse the parent's `metadata.user_id`, that routers keyed on session id replay history and queue them on one lease, and the inferred `(session id, agent id)` key; neither the env-vars page nor the sub-agents page on code.claude.com documents that field, so nothing was added or contradicted.
